verdicts.reason: Both shrink the skyscraper photo, the original's key image, to a tiny sliver on the left edge, where it crashes into the headline ('the'/'limit'). Both also break the headline into a narrow right-aligned column and leave large empty bands above and below it. A wraps into 6 uneven lines ('is not' on one line, the others single words) at a smaller size, so even more of the canvas sits empty. B puts one word on each of 7 lines at a larger, more legible size and fills more of the height, but it has the same image collision and loses the photo just as badly.
